trends.name: Iran-Israel Military Escalation
trends.summary: Israel targeted Iranian railways and bridges; Trump warned Iran "a whole civilization will die tonight" with Tuesday deadline looming. State-linked Iranian media suspended diplomatic communications with US. Oil prices spiked to $116/barrel; King Fahd Causeway closed due to attack threats. Market showing unusual numbness despite extreme geopolitical rhetoric.

trends.name: Trump Impeachment Odds Surge
trends.summary: Prediction markets now price ~69% chance Trump is impeached before 2028, with odds trending higher in recent months. Discussions of 25th Amendment procedures emerging amid heated rhetoric and policy uncertainty. Political risk premium embedding into equity valuations.

trends.name: AI Leadership Battle: OpenAI vs Anthropic
trends.summary: Anthropic appears to have overtaken OpenAI on key financial metrics; concurrent with Sam Altman's latest clash with Elon Musk. Walter Isaacson discussing OpenAI's internal dynamics and leadership. Signals shifting competitive dynamics in generative AI space.

trends.name: Semiconductor Sector Pressure
trends.summary: Google's recent actions hit highflying tech stocks; Arm stock falling despite Wall Street hype (Morgan Stanley downgrade). Micron flagged as crowded cyclical bet. Intel teaming with Elon Musk on chip venture. Sector-wide valuation concerns emerging despite AI demand tailwinds.

trends.name: GLP-1 Weight Loss Market Expansion
trends.summary: Novo Nordisk's explosive Wegovy pill launch drawing new wave of patients into GLP-1 treatment category. Amgen's thyroid eye disease data outperformed Viridian rival. Market recognizing broader TAM and adoption curve for obesity/metabolic treatment class.

trends.name: Tech Stock Correction & Relief Rally Risk
trends.summary: Google's recent actions punishing highflying tech stocks; MarketWatch warns relief rallies may be trap. Market commentary suggests investor caution despite modest selloff (-0.28% S&P, -0.42% NASDAQ at open). Broadening valuation scrutiny across mega-cap tech.

trends.name: Energy Markets Surge on Geopolitical Risk
trends.summary: US oil prices topped $116/barrel after Iran strikes; Russia's Norsi Oil Refinery suspended processing since April 5 drone attack. Energy stocks identified as particularly cheap despite elevated crude prices. Supply chain disruption fears driving both immediate volatility and long-term positioning.

trends.name: Retail Investing Boom & Gen Z Savers
trends.summary: Trump Accounts propelling Robinhood to next generation of investors (CEO Vlad Tenev). Gen Z supersavers helping propel IRA contributions to record highs. Retail participation metrics reaching new peaks despite macro uncertainty.

trends.name: M&A Activity in Infrastructure & Diversified
trends.summary: SBA Communications shares jumped on takeover potential; Whitestone REIT elevated on acquisition buzz but facing rising risks. Universal Music stock rose after Pershing Square's $64B takeover proposal. Consolidation activity picking up in real estate and infrastructure sectors.

trends.name: Valuation Resets Across Growth Stocks
trends.summary: Trane Technologies fully valued with cooling upside; Arm falling on Morgan Stanley downgrade; Nike showing continued revenue growth concerns. Micron positioned as crowded cyclical bet. Broad-based repricing of previously expensive growth names as macro headwinds emerge.

trends.name: Used Car Market Tightening & Inflation Signals
trends.summary: Used car prices rise to highest point since summer 2023, signaling consumer demand resilience or inventory constraint. Chrysler CEO signals minivan 'resurgence' but stays quiet on details. Auto sector showing mixed signals on consumer health and inventory dynamics.

trends.name: Regulatory & Healthcare Policy Risks
trends.summary: Nursing home operators facing crackdown over drugging patients and falsifying records. SEC commentary on 90-day vs long-term financial mindset. House Democrats pushing crackdown on offshore prediction market war bets. Regulatory environment tightening across healthcare and financial services.
